hero.title: Excellence in Hand- Crafted Leather Goods
hero.intro: KINGS - A vertically integrated multi-product and multi-brand company engaged in manufacturing of sustainable leather goods meticulously crafted with traditional skill & modern technology.

story.heading: From a small workshop to a vertically integrated modern facility
paragraphs: KINGS has been the first generation family-owned leather company with an in-house Tannery having a capacity of processing 200 hides per day. Kings International has been dedicated to producing premium leather and leather goods for international markets. Our expertise of skilled workforce and commitment to quality enabled us to manufacture products that meets the expectations of leading global brands. We combine traditional craftsmanship with modern manufacturing technology to produce leather that offers superior strength

durability and finish. Every stage of production is carefully monitored to ensure consistent quality and customer satisfaction. Whether you require finished leather or leather accessories or customized manufacturing solutions. Kings International is a reliable & dependable business partner for sustainable products.

items.title: Kings International Ltd.
items.body: Founded in Kanpur - the heart of India's leather industry - with a focus on hand-crafted leather goods.

items.title: Saddlery & Export Foundations
items.body: Building deep expertise in saddlery and harness manufacturing, and establishing export market worldwide & Participating in International trade fairs.

items.title: Vertical Integration
items.body: Creating In-house tanning & finishing facilities, giving full control over leather quality from through to finished leather.

items.title: Certifications & Sustainability
items.body: Aligning different Management Systems such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001. ISO 50000, SA 8000, Gold Rating of Leather Working Group for Sustainable Leather manufacturing, using REACH compliant chemicals.

items.title: Brand Portfolio
items.body: Growing a multi-brand portfolio, including Ryder Belts, Target for Hunting Accessories, Kingston and Equitel for saddlery & harness products

items.title: Global Reach
items.body: Serving different brands of wholesalers, distributors, retailers, and OEM partners across international markets from our integrated facility.

beliefs.heading: 11 things we won't compromise on.
items: Decades of expertise - founded 1977, still hands-on today.
Premium materials: buffalo and cow hides, selected, not settled for.
Traditional skill and modern technology, working in the same room.
Private label or full OEM - we flex to your specification, not ours.
Vertically integrated - tanning to finishing, under one roof.
Global export experience: compliance, documentation, on-time delivery.
Ethical business - fair labour, transparency, responsible sourcing.
Sustainability isn't a slogan: REACH-compliant chemicals, water recycling, renewable energy.
Every product is inspected before it leaves, not just before it's sold.
Customer-first - from development to after-sales, real people respond.
We build long-term partnerships, not one-off orders.

craftsmanship.heading: Our craftsmanship.
craftsmanship.intro: Master tanners, saddlers, cutters, and stitchers - many with decades on the same floor. We don't publish headshots; we publish the work.

houses.intro: Kingston, Equitel, Ryder, Target and Pets' Pal - each built for its own category, all cut, stitched and finished on the same Kanpur floor.
